A lightweight mod that cleans old, unused log files.

The best thing is that this mod keeps files not based on creation date, but the most recent access (of any kind) to the file, so logs that are still being accessed for whatever reason are not removed unwillingly.

It works both client-side only and server-side only, and works in every Minecraft version.

aitk:
Arrow In The Knee

 "I used to be an adventurer like you, then I took an arrow in the knee..." 
 Now every mob in Minecraft can share that experience! 

---

 📖 Description

 Bring the iconic Skyrim meme to life in Minecraft! 
"Arrow In The Knee" is a simple yet satisfying mod that extends the vanilla arrow-stuck-in-body rendering to all living entities , not just players. In vanilla Minecraft, only players display arrows embedded in their bodies after being shot — with AITK, every cow, zombie, skeleton, and creature in your world will proudly wear their battle scars. Because no adventurer (or mob) should be spared from taking an arrow to the knee.

---

 🌟 Features

- Arrows on all entities : Every living mob now visually displays arrows stuck in their body after being shot, just like players do in vanilla.
- Faithful to vanilla : Uses the same rendering logic as the vanilla arrow sys

About

Are you tired of swapping armor while exploring the nether because those pesky piglins don't approve of your outfit?

Important note

This is an unofficial continuation of CuriosAPI by TheIllusiveC4 for NeoForge (in current state) and Forge (in future). Please, don't report issues of this port to TheIllusiveC4, use separated github issues page or discord invite instead. Mod description and documentation will be updated soon, so stay tuned!

 Overview

Curios is a flexible and expandable accessory/equipment API for users and developers. The purpose is to provide functionality for developers to add extra accessory/equipment slots in a convenient and compatible manner, as well as to give users the ability to configure these slots to their preferences. By default, Curios does not add any content except for an inventory GUI. There are no slots and only two items, the latter only being available through the Creative menu and primarily serving as examples for developers to use when coding their own integration

caelum:
Caelum 

 

Caelum is a Minecraft mod, that aims to make the Minecraft sky more realistic by calculating the positions of the major solar system objects (namely the Earth and Moon) based on their Keplerian orbital elements for the given date.

 Features
 choose whether to use the Vanilla or custom stars (or whether to render stars at all)
 add or even replace the custom stars using resource packs
 add and edit celestial objects like moons and planets
 enable/disable star color (does not apply to Vanilla stars)
 change star size (does not apply to Vanilla stars)
 change the speed of passage of time (i.e. how long the day and night are)
 have a different length of the day depending on your latitude (the Z coordinate) - resulting in polar days and nights near polar regions.

PackagedAuto is an addon to Applied Energistics 2 , and it aims to use "packages" of items to allow autocrafting with more than 9 items, and for 1.18.2+, fluid crafting is also supported. This mod is designed to be able to run without Applied Energistics 2, but installation with it is recommended. 
 To use this mod, one needs to make 2 Recipe Pattern Holders and encode them with an Encoder. Then, one needs to put a pattern holder in a Packager, and the other in an Unpackager, both connected to a ME Network. The Packager will accept items and make them into Recipe Packages and the Unpackager will take them and output items into an adjacent inventory. Both machines tell the ME Network what it can do according to the pattern holder, and the Packager, when connected, ejects packages into the network. 
 No Fabric port is currently planned, however if anyone wants to do a port, you are welcome

audition:
Audition

Audition is a client-side Fabric mod that thins out sound in noisy areas: mob farms, explosions and busy redstone builds. It drops distant and duplicate sounds before they start, so the sounds near you stay clear and fewer sounds compete for Minecraft's limited sound channels.

---

 How it decides

Every sound request is checked before vanilla allocates a channel for it:

- Always plays: player, UI and voice sounds, sounds attached to you (such as music), and anything within 8 blocks.
- Always dropped: sounds more than 32 blocks away. Most vanilla sounds are already silent at that distance.
- In between (8–32 blocks): 
 - If the same sound has already played this tick, repeats are dropped.
 - Each remaining sound gets a priority from its distance and category. Low-priority sounds are dropped. Quieter categories such as ambient and weather go first, and mobs and blocks are rare

Chat Macro 

Chat Macro is a simple but extremely flexible Minecraft mod that lets you create your own chat-based macros. 
It doesn’t come with predefined commands you can add any command or message you want and trigger it instantly using customizable keys or combinations.

---

 What Chat Macro Does

- Create your own macros 
- Assign a chat message or command to each macro 
- Trigger that macro instantly using ALT , SHIFT , CTRL , or combinations of them 
- Run the command in chat without typing anything manually 

If you frequently repeat certain commands on servers, this mod becomes a powerful shortcut tool.

---

 How It Works

1. Open the Chat Macro settings in-game. (or use keybind C , only work on 26.1+ versions)
2. Add a new macro. 
3. Type in any message or command (e.g., /home , /warp , /msg player Hello , or any custom text). 
4. Assign a keybind using ALT , SHIFT , CTRL , or

enchanted-cauldron-fix:
Enchanted Cauldron Fix

A tiny, focused fix for cauldron heating in Enchanted: Witchcraft.

 The bug

1. Place a cauldron over a heat source.
2. Fill it with 3 buckets of water.
3. Put in a recipe - it completes normally.
4. Fill it with 3 buckets of water again.
5. The cauldron never boils or becomes ready to cook again.

The only workarounds were adding a 4th bucket (which nudges the blockstate even though the cauldron is already full) or breaking and replacing the cauldron entirely.

 What this mod does

Fixes the cauldron so it properly starts heating again after being refilled following a completed recipe, without needing the bucket trick or a rebuild.

 Requirements

- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Enchanted: Witchcraft

Optis

 Optis is a client-side performance mod that intelligently manages Minecraft’s texture memory to reduce VRAM usage and prevent stutters. 

Instead of keeping every texture loaded in GPU memory, Optis tracks which textures are actively used and dynamically adjusts their residency. Unused textures can be safely demoted or unloaded while frequently used textures remain ready for rendering.

This helps stabilize performance in large worlds, modpacks, and texture-heavy environments where GPU memory pressure can cause lag spikes or stuttering.

---

configbackuper:
A simple mod for backing up all configurations at the start of Minecraft.

 Mod review with subtitles

 

 Features

- Backs up configurations at the start of Minecraft
- Backs up game configurations
- Backs up mod configurations
- Backs up shader configurations
- Compression of backups
- Removes old backups

 Configuration

The configuration file is located at config/config-backuper.json .

- includeGameConfigs - add game configurations to the backup
- includeModConfigs - add mod configurations to the backup
- includeShaderPackConfigs - add shader configurations to the backup
- maxBackups - maximum number of stored backups ( -1 disables deletion of old backups, default 10 )
- compressionEnabled - use compression for backups (enabling compression reduces the size of the backup, but slows down its creation a bit)
- backupFolder - directory for backups ( ./ - current game directory)

This mod is inspired by the german Minecraft project: " Minecraft Helden ".

This mod is mainly for multiplayer and for PvP SMPs. Every player gets 3 hearts (lives). If they lose them all, they get banned. When a player attacks another player, they get into a 30 second combat phase. They only lose a heart when they die while being in this combat phase. If the players leave the game while being in the combat phase, they will die and lose a heart!

- /hearts get (player) -- displays the amount of hearts of a player.

Animon SoundFix

Animon SoundFix is a client-side Cobblemon addon made to work alongside the Animon resource pack. It can also be used with other Cobblemon resource packs that add custom Pokémon ambient and cry sounds.
The mod helps prevent owned or battling Pokémon from playing their ambient sound at the same time as their cry, such as when they are sent out or when a cry animation plays. Wild Pokémon can still use their normal ambient sounds, keeping the world feeling alive without causing doubled audio.
It also adds fallback support for Pokémon that have cry animations but no proper Cobblemon sound trigger, allowing compatible resource-pack cries to play where they normally would not.

Cut videos based on your gameplay!

 Usage
1. Install FFmpeg
2. Install OBS
3. Open OBS
4. In OBS, go to Tools - WebSocket Server Settings
5. Enable web server
6. Under Tools - WebSocket Server Settings, go to Connection Information and copy the password
7. In game, run /autocut connect 
8. Start Recording in OBS
9. Do fun gameplay stuff
10. Stop Recording in OBS
11. (optional) Delete clips you don't want (see the wiki)
12. Run /autocut finish 
13. When it's finished a new video starting with cut will be in your recordings folder.

Gravel Carts

 Minecarts travel wayyy faster on rails on gravel.

In Minecraft, there are minecarts, which are an obsolete form of transportation. Nearly every type of transportation in the game is better than it--elytras, horses, boats (especially on ice), and even sprint-jumping with a block above your head. That being said, minecarts do have a very good application at the moment: redstone. If minecarts' speed were to simply be increased to better compete with other forms of transportation, it would negatively affect redstone applications. So, a compromise: the blocks underneath the rails determine the minecarts' max speed. 

In this mod there are a variety of ways to increase the minecarts' speed:
- Cobblestone or Cobbled Deepslate underneath rails increases minecarts' max speed to 1.5x normal max speed
- Gravel underneath rails increases minecarts' max speed to 2.0x normal max speed

Create: Interval Filter

A small addon for Create that adds the Interval Filter - a filter item that
configures a Deployer to activate at set distance intervals as a contraption moves.

 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

---

 What does it do?

Building automated contraptions in Create often requires placing items at precise, repeating intervals, something vanilla Deployers can't do on their own. The Interval Filter solves this. Place it in a Deployer's filter slot and it controls the cadence of activations: place items every 3rd block, every 10th block, or any interval up to 64, with an optional offset to phase-shift where the pattern starts.

This opens up builds that were previously tedious or impossible to tune, such as:

- Evenly-spaced torch placement behind a mining drill
- Repeating decoration patterns on a wall or floor
- Skipping the first few blocks before a pattern begins
- Alternating

vouch:
Vouch

 
 
 

Vouch is a secure, server-side authentication mod designed for modern Minecraft. It handles player registration, login, and two-factor authentication entirely on the server, meaning players do not need to install anything on their clients to join.

We currently support Minecraft 1.21.1 through 1.21.4 on both Fabric and NeoForge.

 How it works

When a player joins, they are placed in a "pre-auth" state where they cannot move, interact, or see chat until they log in.
 New players use /register to create an account.
 Returning players use /login to access the server.
 Session Persistence: If a player disconnects and reconnects quickly from the same IP, their session is remembered so they don't have to type their password again immediately.

 Key Features

 Security & Performance 
We use Argon2id for password hashing, which is the current industry standard for security. Crucia

担保 Vouch是一个为现代Minecraft设计的安全的服务器端认证模组。它完全在服务器上处理玩家注册、登录和双因素认证，这意味着玩家不需要在客户端上安装任何东西就可以加入。 我们目前在Fabric和NeoForge上都支持Minecraft 1.21.1到1.21.4。 它是如何工作 当玩家加入时，他们将处于"预授权"状态，在此状态下，他们在登录之前不能移动、交互或查看聊天。 新玩家使用/注册来创建帐户。 回归玩家使用/login来访问服务器。 会话持久性：如果玩家从同一个IP快速断开并重新连接，他们的会话将被记住，因此他们不必立即再次键入密码。 关键特征 安全性与性能 我们使用Argon2id进行密码哈希，这是当前的安全行业标准。Crucia

retroEMI Forge 

An unofficial port of EMI to 1.7.10 Forge and 1.12.2 Forge/Cleanroom

EMI is a featureful and accessible item and recipe viewer. It brings many new features, and optimizes for the user experience. Now, you only need to install UniMixins (MixinBooter) and GTNH Lib additionally to enjoy EMI on 1.7.10/1.12.2 Forge.

---

 Runtime NEIU / JEI / HEI Compat

tracker-compass:
Tracker Compass
A Minecraft datapack that adds a compass which tracks the nearest player. Primarily intended for Minecraft Manhunts.

 Features
- Track multiple players - the compass will point to the nearest target.
- Remembers the last position tracked, even if the runner enters a different dimension. Also works if the hunter dies (but the compass will not remember the dimension it was last used in before the hunter's death).
- Hunters are not able to lose or drop their compass.
- Runners are not able to pick up or use tracker compasses.

 Installation
Datapack version:
- Download latest release
- Locate your world's datapack folder ( .minecraft/saves/[your world name]/datapacks )
- Place the datapack into the datapack folder
- Make sure the datapack is enabled by using /datapack list . If it isn't, enable it with /datapack enable "file/tracker-compass (version number).zip" 

Mod versi

A lightweight, highly configurable Fabric, Forge & NeoForge mod that completely overhauls how mobs react to light, heat, and darkness.

 Photophobic Mobs introduces a dynamic contrast between light fearing monsters, shadow stalkers, and light seeking creatures turning light sources into tactical survival tools and breathing realistic life into mob behavior!

Low Latency

中文

This mod is designed to reduce input latency when the GPU is full load and the CPU is not, inspired by NVIDIA Reflex.

When the gpu is full load and the CPU is not, a frame queue backlog will build up, the input latency will increase.

This mod estimates input latency based on historical CPU and GPU frame times, and waits before input events to ensure the frame queue will not build up, which reduces input latency.

 This project is in its early stages, which may result in reduced frame rates or increased latency. You can adjust the ‘wait time offset’ in the config menu to alleviate this issue. 

You can enable/disable low latency feature in config menu.

neologin:
NeoLogin is a lightweight, high-performance, and secure authorization mod for Minecraft servers running on NeoForge 1.21.1. The mod protects player accounts on offline-mode (cracked) servers by requiring authentication upon joining. 

It is designed with a focus on stability under load, enterprise-grade password security, console privacy, and ease of administration.

Key Features:
- Flexible Database Storage: Out-of-the-box support for local SQLite storage (does not require any configuration) and remote MySQL database support for multi-server networks.
- Enhanced Password Security (PBKDF2): Passwords are protected using PBKDF2 with HMAC-SHA256 (120,000 iterations and cryptographic salt). Existing legacy SHA-256 hashes are automatically upgraded to PBKDF2 upon the player's next successful login.
- Pre-auth Player Locking: Unauthenticated players are temporarily switched to Spectator mode

NeoLogin是一个轻量级、高性能、安全的授权模组，适用于运行NeoForge 1.21.1的Minecraft服务器。该模组通过在加入时要求身份验证来保护离线模式（已破解）服务器上的玩家帐户。 它的设计重点是负载稳定性、企业级密码安全性、控制台隐私性和易于管理性。 主要特点： - 灵活的数据库存储：对本地SQLite存储的现成支持（不需要任何配置）和对多服务器网络的远程MySQL数据库支持。 - 增强的密码安全性（PBKDF 2）：使用PBKDF 2搭配HMAC-SHA 256（120，000次反覆运算和加密Salt）来保护密码。现有的旧版SHA-256杂凑会在玩家下次成功登入时自动升级为PBKDF 2。 - 预认证玩家锁定：未经认证的玩家被临时切换到旁观者模式

A mixin shim for Minecraft 1.20.1 (Fabric) that fixes the launch crash when Apugli 2.10.x runs with Origins 1.10.2 (Apoli 2.9.2).

 Read this first. Apugli has been delisted from Modrinth and CurseForge and its repo is archived. There is no 1.21 build and there will not be one. This mod only helps if your pack already has Apugli 2.10.x sitting in mods/ . If you are starting fresh, this is not for you.

 The crash

Apugli's EntityConditionsMixin uses @Redirect to intercept EnchantmentHelper.getLevel() and EnchantmentHelper.getEquipmentLevel() inside Apoli's EntityConditions.lambda$register$47 . In Apoli 2.9.2 those calls live in lambda$register$45 .

Lambda numbers are compiler-generated and they move between Apoli versions, so the redirect finds 0 targets and takes the game down with it:

 
InjectionError: Critical injection failure: Redirector apugli$useModifiedEnchantmentLevelSum

A fruit fly with a real brain. All 158,262 neurons of it, running live inside your world.

cbc-ballistics-fix-sable:
CBC Sable Rangefinder Fix is a lightweight patch that prevents game-freezing lag when combining CBC Ballistics with Create Aeronautics (Sable).

The Problem
When using the CBC Ballistics Rangefinder on a Create Aeronautics physics ship, the game calculates target coordinates that are millions of blocks away. If this data is sent to the Artillery Coordinator via the Radio set, the mod attempts to render massive particle dispersion circles and lines. This instantly spawns millions of particles, hitting the Minecraft engine cap and freezing the game completely.

The Fix
This mod uses Mixins to safely cap particle generation:

Corrects DetectingProjectile to register the true global coordinate of a ship.
Hard-caps the ParticleHelper renderer so it never spawns more than a safe amount of particles (max 100 per circle / 200 per line), completely eliminating the FPS drops and crashes.

Sledgehammers adds 7 new Sledgehammer items. Sledgehammers are multi-tool items that are efficient against any and every block. When charged and released, Sledgehammers can excavate, vein mine, and fell trees. There's a Sledgehammer for every vanilla tool tier: Wood, Stone, Iron, Gold, Diamond, Netherite. The last tier is called "Starlight" and is a hard-to-craft but unbreakable Sledgehammer.
 
 Modpack Policy 
You can use this mod in any modpack whether it's public or private. Just do not claim this mod as your own!

dyeable-books:
Allows you to dye your books and quills to write with. You must first dye the book and quill and then write the book, dyeing the written book will not work.

 Currently supported books (and crafting guide)
- Dye colours (dye + book and quill)
- Skull book (bone + book and quill)
- Heart book (redstone dust + book and quill)
- Star book (glowstone dust + book and quill)
- Knowledge (crafting) book (crafting table + book and quill)
- You can add a snowball to reset the book and quill

 Remove enchantment glint
Additionally, adding sand to a book and quill will remove the enchantment glint. This must be done in the same recipe as the dyeing.

bell-distance-plus-plus:
No more searching for raider❌🔎

The original mechanic assumes that the radius of raid illumination is 32 blocks.

This is annoying when you try to find the last raider in a raid, and the bell can't detect him because the radius is too small.

My mod increases the raid lighting radius to 100 blocks (I would have made the radius larger, but this is a limitation of the "GLOW" effect, and I didn't want to rewrite the effect code).

 Why my mod?😎

There are already mods that perform the same function as mine, but all of them I've seen don't work on fabric 1.20.1. For example, the "Bell Finds All Raiders" datapack doesn't work in 1.20.1, but my mod does

 Installation📥
requires fabric API

playerviewdistance:
PlayerViewDistance

Give every player their own server-side view distance without making the entire server pay for the largest setting.

PlayerViewDistance (PVD) is a dedicated-server mod and plugin for Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Paper, and Folia. It controls chunk loading and sending per player, merges nearby coverage exactly, and keeps expensive planning away from the main server thread.

 Why use PVD?

- Per-player distances: uses each player's client request or a persistent operator override.
- Less unnecessary loading: beyond the simulation floor, a player capped at distance 2 does not make PVD load distance 8 solely for them.
- Off-thread planning: geometry, overlap calculations, prioritisation, and governor decisions run on one coalescing planner thread.
- Safe simulation behavior: PVD does not change simulation distance, entity ticking, redstone, random ticks, or another mod's tick

Sleep Vote

 Vote to skip the night. 

Sleep Vote replaces the vanilla sleep mechanic with a community vote system. Instead of needing a majority of players to physically sleep in beds, anyone can trigger a vote and let the server decide democratically whether to skip the night.

 How It Works

When a player right-clicks a bed during the night, a server-wide vote is automatically started. All players have 15 seconds (configurable) to cast their vote. If at least half of the server votes yes, the night is skipped instantly.

 Commands

 Command Description 
 --- --- 
 /sleep yes Vote to skip the night 
 /sleep no Vote to keep the night 
 /sleep reload Reload the config without restarting (operators only) 

 Vote Rules

- A vote is triggered automatically when a player interacts with a bed at night
- Players can only vote once per vote
- The vote passes if there are more yes than no votes

After the last clan servers went offline and the worlds became unusable, nothing remained, only fragments.
The logs ended abruptly.
Player data was deleted.
The files were considered lost.

But then, months later, a strange file appeared in the old server backups:
user 01 reconnect.log

No one knows who created it.
It was not part of the original Broken Script.
And yet it contained lines of code that looked suspiciously similar to the old script – only altered, as if rewritten by someone or something.

When someone tried to open the file, the server activated again, even without a host, without an IP, without a login.
A single new player appeared in the log:

[Server] new connection detected.
[Entity tag missing.]
[assigning placeholder: GHOST]

You are that new player.
No one knows if you are real or just an echo of what used to be here.
But the script responds to you.

This datapack adds mailboxes in the form of barrels that can be used to send and receive items between other players. This is intended for multiplayer use on servers.

 
 
 

 Setting up your mailbox
Look directly at an empty barrel which you want to make your mailbox, then run the command /trigger set-mailbox . Said barrel is now your mailbox. Whenever other players send you any items, those items will appear in your mailbox.

If you want to change the position of your mailbox, break your current mailbox and follow the steps above again.

 Sending mail to other players

 Moxvallix's Datapack Creation Library

Moxlib aims to make Datapack creation fun and enjoyable.

With a predictable API, and a focus on data driven functionality, Moxlib serves
as an excellent foundation to any Datapack project.

Moxlib aims to run as little as possible on the tick function. Most functions
in the pack only run when they are called.

Another focus of the pack is instantaneous functions. Most of the functions
in the pack have been designed to run in a single tick, and do not use schedules,
or other timer based methods.

Moxlib is licensed under the GNU LGPL, meaning you are free to use it in your
own Datapacks, themselves under any license, but any changes you make to Moxlib must
be released under the terms of the LGPL. See LICENSE.md for full license.

Suggestions and contributions welcomed!

 The API
 Conventions
Any function outside of the moxlib:api folder is c

fps-boost-kulustur:
A performance-focused texture pack that simplifies textures — from flat 1x1 colors to small 4x4/8x8 detail — to boost FPS, especially on lower-end PCs.

What's included so far:
- Flat-colored terrain blocks (stone, sand, obsidian, deepslate, andesite, granite, diorite, dirt, grass, and more)
- All overworld wood types (logs + planks) and opaque leaves
- Resized held tools, shield, and colored ore outlines for easy identification
- Simplified liquids, nether portal, fire overlay, and particle effects
- Flat wool with a border outline
- Custom green gap-style crosshair

A few things are kept close to vanilla on purpose:
- Gravel is untouched, so falling gravel is still easy to notice
- Diorite stays slightly detailed, to avoid being confused with andesite/granite
- Powder snow keeps a blue warning outline instead of going fully flat

Still in active development — more textures and features

一款注重性能的材质包，可简化材质（从单调的1x 1颜色到小的4x 4/8x8细节），以提高帧数，尤其是在低端PC上。 到目前为止包括的内容： - 单色地形方块（石头、沙子、黑曜石、深板岩、安山岩、花岗岩、闪长岩、泥土、草等） - 世界各地所有木材类型（原木+木板）和不透明树叶 - 调整了手持工具、护罩和有色矿石轮廓的尺寸，便于识别 - 简化的液体、幽冥之门、火焰叠加和粒子效果 - 带镶边的扁平羊毛 - 自定义绿色间隙式十字准线 有几样东西是故意放在原版旁边的： - 砾石未被触及，因此下落的砾石仍然很容易被注意到 - 闪长岩保持略微详细，以避免与安山岩/花岗岩混淆 - 粉雪保持蓝色的警告轮廓，而不是完全平坦 仍在积极开发中-更多材质和特性

Better Weather
 Better Weather is a Resource Pack that alters Minecraft's weather particles to be slightly more realistic. 
- Minecraft's weather particles are just...too big to be natural. The snowflakes are the size of a player's fist, each raindrop probably extends to half the player's size, for some reason. Better Weather fixes all that, making snowflakes single white pixels, making the cold biomes feel cozier, rain is now smaller and slightly transparent, making it be more realistic and refreshing.
 Known Issues
- None so far!

 Terms of Use
- You may take this Resource Pack and do whatever you like with it, so long as you do not republish or share the edited version.

Camellia is a pathtracer shader for Minecraft.
It's my take on Quad Raytracing in Minecraft, using the state of the art techniques from the H-PLOC paper to build a BVH directly on the GPU.

viewdistancetweaks:
ViewDistanceTweaks

Sets view and simulation distance per world, on its own, based on what the server can handle at that moment.

---

The number in server.properties has to be safe enough for your worst minute, which means it's too low for every other minute. Ten people on at 3am and you're saving distance nobody asked you to save. Sixty people at an event and that same number is why the TPS meter is on the floor.

This moves it for you. It watches MSPT and how many chunks are actually loaded, gives distance back while there's headroom, and takes it away before players notice. Each world has its own floor and ceiling, so the Nether can sit at 6 while your main world runs at 16.

Drop the jar in and restart. The defaults do something sensible without any setup.

---

 Requirements

- Paper 1.21.x / 26.x or a fork (Purpur, Pufferfish, Leaves)
- Folia works, tested on 1.21.11
